cds.text: Respond to counting, to two collections being compared, to groups of familiar objects, and to items added or removed
Respond to identifying objects
Respond to objects by length and to everyday routine events
Respond to familiar everyday shapes and objects
Respond to an object's movement
Respond to objects that suit a given context
Count with the words one, two and three; match one object to one count word; recognise none, one and more; join in adding and taking away
Compare objects to notice what is the same and different
Compare objects directly by placing them side by side; recognise familiar daily routines
Identify whether two shapes or objects are the same kind
Respond to simple statements about position or direction
Take part in collecting data
Count in order to five; match number names, numerals and quantities to three; say one, more or less; compare two collections; add or take away one
Pair identical objects from a small set and recognise a simple repeating pattern
Compare two objects by length; recognise parts of the day and sequence them on a visual schedule
Match familiar 2D shapes and 3D objects
Find named 3D objects in the classroom
Identify data that suits a given context
Count aloud in everyday situations to 10; recognise numerals and quantities from five; see small groups to five at a glance; compare two collections; model adding and taking away to five
Sort objects by a feature; spot a simple repeating pattern and say what comes next
Compare weight and capacity; order the school day's events and say if short or long; name the days in order; sort objects and shapes by direct comparison
Follow simple directions using on, in and under
Answer yes or no questions about information collected in a familiar setting
